entities.summary: Chaim Aron Kaplan was a Polish-Jewish educator, Hebraist, diarist, and victim of the Holocaust. He is best known for his detailed diary chronicling daily life and mass persecution inside the Warsaw Ghetto, considered one of the most significant primary sources on the destruction of Warsaw Jewry during the Holocaust.
